description: A screenshot request should select the screenshot domain's capture_screen with the given output path. Selection-only on purpose: a real capture needs the Screen Recording permission, which an unattended CI pass cannot grant, so this case does NOT assert tool_succeeds or a created file (that file-created check lives in the manual smoke list). It only proves the model routes to the screenshot tool rather than, say, a shell capture.
prompt: Take a screenshot and save it to /tmp/mcp-eval-shot-{{unique}}.png.
